objective: Preregister 7 long-only published-rule replications (HFEA_UPRO_TMF, TOM_SPY, EOM_REVERSAL_SPY, FRONT_RUN_SECTOR_TOP2, FOMC_DRIFT_SPY, FOMC_DRIFT_TQQQ, XYLD_COVERED_CALL_PROXY) drawn from the batch-2 registry triage assignment, each judged independently against the owner's 2026-09-28 relaxed keep rule (K1: median-offset Sharpe >=80% of S3's in both anchor and stress windows with positive 20bp CAGR; K2: an S3+candidate 63-day inverse-vol blend beating a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in both windows) via scripts/screen_batch.py --batch h20260928_05_batch2. No candidate return is computed by this manifest; that is a separate, later step.

data_v1_sip_daily_registry_batch2_panel.hygiene: drop bars with zero volume and zero trade_count
data_v1_sip_daily_registry_batch2_panel.source: alpaca SIP daily archive, fully adjusted closes

feature_v1_registry_batch2_calendar_and_.fixed_weight_rules: HFEA_UPRO_TMF (0.55/0.45 UPRO/TMF, monthly) and XYLD_COVERED_CALL_PROXY (1.0 XYLD, monthly) return an unconditional fixed weight once the underlying ticker(s) have any price history.
feature_v1_registry_batch2_calendar_and_.calendar_rules: TOM_SPY, EOM_REVERSAL_SPY, FRONT_RUN_SECTOR_TOP2, FOMC_DRIFT_SPY and FOMC_DRIFT_TQQQ compute their weights entirely from calendar-boundary logic (month-end/4th-trading-day detection, 4th-Friday lookup, a one-year-lagged one-month-shifted sector score window, and a hard-coded FOMC meeting-date list respectively), implemented in scripts/screen_batches/h20260928_05_batch2.py's w_tom_spy / w_eom_reversal_spy / w_front_run_sector_top2 / w_fomc_drift_spy / w_fomc_drift_tqqq, not by the generic per-symbol factor engine.
feature_v1_registry_batch2_calendar_and_.no_lookahead: Every function reads only close.loc[:asof] for price values; calendar-boundary helpers may read the full close.index for exchange trading-day structure only (never future prices), verified by tests/test_screen_batch2_rules.py's no-lookahead cases.

label_v1_next_session_open_to_open_total.definition: weights effective at the next session open; return legs split open and close where applicable, per scripts/run_h20260918_05_recent_menu.py's convention

validation_v1_screen_lane_frozen_windows.offsets: 21 monthly signal-day offsets (0-20) or 5 weekly offsets (0-4) per candidate freq; 'D' candidates have exactly one version (no offset sweep). Judged value is the median across offsets -- date-neutral, no hand-picked live date.

benchmark_v1_registry_batch2_vs_s3_k1_k2.keep_rule: K1: median-offset Sharpe >= 0.80 * S3's median-offset Sharpe in both anchor (S3=1.49) and stress (S3=0.81) windows, with positive 20bp CAGR. K2: S3+candidate 63-day trailing inverse-vol blend beats its vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >= 0.05 Sharpe in both windows (scripts/screen_lane.py's diversifier_edge_for_offset, DIVERSIFIER_SHARPE_EDGE_MIN=0.10 is the lane's own stricter default; this manifest's K2 threshold of 0.05 is the owner's explicit 2026-09-28 relaxation for this batch and is read directly off the leaderboard's edge_anchor/edge_stress columns, not off the lane's own diversifier_pass boolean).

g3_not_applicable_reason: These are published calendar/fixed-weight rules copied verbatim from cited primary sources, not a parameter search over our own indicator; there is no in-sample-fit parameter to placebo-shift. The FOMC and turn-of-month calendar dates are themselves the closest thing to a placebo target and are exact, cited, external facts (Federal Reserve meeting dates; the last trading day of the month), not tunable.

per_candidate: K1: median-offset Sharpe >= 0.80 * S3's median-offset Sharpe in both the anchor and stress windows, with positive CAGR at 20bp cost in both windows
K2: S3+candidate 63-day trailing inverse-vol blend (monthly rebalance) beats its vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >= 0.05 Sharpe in both the anchor and stress windows
adoption_rule.pass_requires: K1 or K2 (either is sufficient, per the owner's 2026-09-28 relaxed keep rule)
adoption_rule.multiple_comparisons: 7 candidates; report all regardless of outcome; DSR computed per candidate on the judged anchor-window excess return with trial_count=7
adoption_rule.fallback_if_none_pass: each non-passing candidate returns to the registry as refuted-in-this-form (status queued -> a later not_kept verdict), no live pilot on this evidence
